text: 针对近期欧盟对中国车企插混车型出口“限制”一事，中国汽车流通协会乘联分会负责人崔东树表示，欧盟出台相关限制会给中国插混车出口带来一定影响，但国内插混产品竞争力强劲，已实现从电比油高到油电同价、再到电比油低的跨越，在技术、油耗、整车价值体验上全球领先。欧洲此前排斥插混路线，本土产业错失发展机遇，2025~2026年我国插混车出口在欧盟市场爆发，也因此带来竞争压力。（每经）
text_en: Regarding the recent EU "restrictions" on exports of Chinese carmakers' plug-in hybrid models, Cui Dongshu, head of the China Passenger Car Association branch under the China Automobile Dealers Association, said the EU's related restrictions will have some impact on China's plug-in hybrid vehicle exports, but domestic plug-in hybrid products are highly competitive, having achieved a leap from electricity costing more than oil to oil-electric price parity and then to electricity costing less than oil, and are globally leading in technology, fuel consumption, and overall vehicle value experience. Europe previously rejected the plug-in hybrid route, causing its local industry to miss development opportunities. In 2025-2026, China's plug-in hybrid vehicle exports are expected to boom in the EU market, thereby bringing competitive pressure. (National Business Daily)
